chars.MUSTACHE: MUSTACHE: a man with a thick black mustache on his white face, wearing an oversized shiny gold satin shirt open at the collar, very baggy black trousers, white chunky sneakers and a thin silver chain.
chars.SWEDE: SWEDE: a young woman wearing a sleeveless emerald green satin dress, small gold hoop earrings and a thin gold bracelet.
chars.DJ: DJ: a young man wearing a red baseball cap, big black DJ headphones around his neck, a white oversized t-shirt and a black bomber jacket.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Casablanca nightclub with purple and blue neon lights, seen from the DJ booth. MUSTACHE slides in very close behind SWEDE on the dance floor, dancing glued to her back with a cheeky grin, head-to-waist framing, both faces visible. SWEDE is surprised.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Nightclub dance floor, neon lights. MUSTACHE dances right next to SWEDE without saying hello, wiggling his shoulders confidently, pointing at her; SWEDE dances alone, eyes half closed, not yet noticing him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Nightclub dance floor. SWEDE turns her head around toward MUSTACHE, and MUSTACHE quickly hides his face behind his hand, embarrassed and shy, comic moment.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Nightclub, neon lights. SWEDE stands still and looks curiously across the dance floor at MUSTACHE, who dances alone in the background showing off big moves, arms in the air.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Nightclub dance floor. SWEDE walks up to MUSTACHE and starts dancing with him, both smiling and laughing, facing each other, colorful lights.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Behind a DJ booth with turntables and a mixer in a neon nightclub. DJ grips the edge of the booth, staring toward the dance floor, jealous and furious, jaw clenched, neon lights behind him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: DJ booth in a nightclub. DJ, heartbroken, holds one headphone to his ear with tears in his eyes and slowly turns a knob on the mixer, playing a sad song, one hand on his heart, very dramatic and comic.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: View from behind the DJ booth over the dance floor. DJ in the foreground glares with a broken-hearted angry face at MUSTACHE in the background, who dances proudly under the lights; DJ's hand is reaching up to his red cap.
